Senior Executive Assistant (CEO & C-Suite Support) – Remote Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours About the Role At Pavago , one of our clients is hiring a highly experienced Senior Executive Assistant to serve as a strategic partner to the CEO and executive leadership team.

This is a high-impact role responsible for ensuring executives remain organized, focused, and able to operate at their highest level. This goes far beyond traditional administrative support.

You’ll manage executive calendars, communications, travel, strategic projects, and cross-functional coordination while serving as a trusted extension of leadership. Success in this role requires exceptional organization, sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to anticipate needs before they arise.

If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy supporting senior executives, and take ownership of complex priorities, this role is a strong fit. What You’ll Own Executive Calendar & Time Management Manage complex executive calendars across multiple time zones. Coordinate internal and external meetings.

Prioritize schedules while protecting executive focus time. Resolve scheduling conflicts proactively. Prepare meeting agendas, executive briefings, and supporting materials. Ensure leadership remains focused on high-impact priorities. Executive Communications Manage and prioritize executive email communications.

Screen calls and correspondence on behalf of leadership. Draft, edit, and proofread: Emails Reports Presentations Executive communications Serve as a trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders. Maintain professional, diplomatic, and confidential communication at all times.

Travel & Logistics Management Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements. Book flights, accommodations, transportation, and itineraries. Prepare detailed travel schedules and briefing materials. Handle last-minute itinerary changes efficiently. Track and reconcile travel expenses.

Project & Operations Support Support strategic initiatives and executive projects. Track deadlines, deliverables, and action items. Coordinate cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Conduct research and prepare executive summaries. Assist leadership with operational and administrative priorities.

Meeting & Event Coordination Organize: Executive meetings Leadership meetings Board meetings Off-sites Company events Prepare presentations and meeting materials. Take meeting notes and distribute action items. Coordinate virtual and in-person meeting logistics. Administrative Management Maintain confidential records, contracts, and documentation.

Process expense reports, invoices, and budget tracking. Improve administrative systems and workflows. Maintain organized executive files and documentation. Support day-to-day executive office operations. What Success Looks Like Executive calendars run smoothly with minimal oversight. Leadership remains organized, informed, and focused.

Meetings, projects, and follow-ups stay on schedule. Travel and logistics are managed seamlessly. Confidential information is handled with professionalism. Administrative processes continue improving as the business grows. What Makes You a Strong Fit You anticipate executive needs before they arise. You thrive in high-trust environments.

You remain calm under pressure and manage competing priorities effectively. You communicate professionally with executives and stakeholders. You solve problems independently and proactively. You maintain exceptional attention to detail while moving quickly.

Required Experience & Skills Experience 5+ years of experience as an: Executive Assistant Senior Administrative Assistant Chief of Staff Executive Operations professional Proven experience supporting: CEOs Founders Presidents C-Suite executives Experience managing: Complex executive calendars Executive communications High-priority projects Strong organizational and project management skills.

Excellent written and verbal English communication. High level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality. Ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced environments. Nice to Have Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.

Experience supporting executives in: Startups Consulting Finance Legal Technology High-growth organizations Experience coordinating domestic and international travel. Experience preparing executive presentations and reports. Experience supporting board members and senior stakeholders.

Tech Stack Microsoft Office Suite Outlook Word Excel PowerPoint Google Workspace Gmail Calendar Docs Sheets Drive Project Management Tools Asana Monday.com Notion Trello Video Conferencing Zoom Microsoft Teams Google Meet Expense and travel management platforms AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or similar) What a Typical Day Looks Like Review and prioritize the executive inbox.

Manage calendar requests and scheduling conflicts. Coordinate meetings across multiple time zones. Draft executive emails, reports, and presentations. Arrange travel and prepare itineraries. Track strategic initiatives and follow up on action items. Prepare executive briefings and meeting materials.

Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders. Improve administrative workflows and processes. In short: You’ll ensure executives stay organized, informed, and focused by managing priorities, communications, projects, and operations with exceptional precision. Key Metrics for Success (KPIs) Executive calendar accuracy and scheduling efficiency.

Inbox and communication responsiveness. On-time completion of executive projects and follow-ups. Travel planning accuracy and efficiency. Executive satisfaction and stakeholder feedback. Administrative process improvements. Accuracy of documentation and reporting. Why This Role Stands Out Direct partnership with executive leadership.

High ownership and visibility across the business. Opportunity to influence operations and executive effectiveness. Exposure to strategic planning, cross-functional initiatives, and decision-making. Fully remote role with long-term growth opportunities.

Career progression into: Executive Operations Manager Chief of Staff Director of Operations Business Operations Leader Interview Process Application Review Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes) Client Interview Offer & Onboarding What Happens After You Apply After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video .

This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple initial screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your executive support experience, and highlight how you’ve managed executive calendars, communications, travel, projects, and confidential priorities.

You’ll also have the opportunity to explain how you’ve improved executive workflows, supported leadership teams, and used AI productivity tools to work more efficiently. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the client interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

FreeUp is seeking a high-performing Executive Assistant to support the CEO in building structure, reducing distractions, and optimizing daily operations. This role is designed to create clarity and efficiency in a fast-paced executive environment by implementing strong systems for email, scheduling, and task management.

The Executive Assistant will play a critical role in transforming a high-volume inbox and meeting-heavy calendar into a streamlined, priority-driven workflow. Success in this role requires strong judgment, proactive communication, and the ability to create order from complexity. This role goes beyond traditional administrative support.

You will own core operational processes, manage communication systems, coordinate recruiting pipelines, and help implement tools and SOPs that reduce cognitive load for the CEO and leadership team.

This is a full-time, remote position requiring exceptional written communication, strong follow-through, comfort with sensitive information, and the ability to proactively manage both professional and limited personal tasks.

Location: Fully Remote Job Type: Full-Time Salary: $800 - $1,600 per month (based on experience) Requirements 3+ years of experience supporting senior executives as an EA, Operations Coordinator, or similar role.

Exceptional email management and prioritization skills Strong systems thinker with experience building organized workflows Proficient in digital tools (Notion strongly preferred) Highly proactive and detail-oriented Strong written communication skills Comfortable making judgment calls on prioritization Tech-comfortable and adaptable to evolving systems and tools.

Thrives in high-accountability, high-clarity environments. Technical Requirements: Reliable high-speed internet and a modern home office setup.

Key Responsibilities Email & Communication Management Implementing and managing a structured email triage system (initially 8 categories, refined over time) Sorting and prioritizing incoming messages daily Identifying revenue-generating and high-impact emails for Executive's direct attention Delegating actionable items to appropriate team members Extracting tasks from emails and moving them into a task management system (Notion) Drafting routine responses and gradually taking ownership of standard communications Preparing a prioritized daily action summary during sync meetings Maintaining inbox organization to reduce actionable emails to a minimal, high-impact lis Meeting & Calendar Coordination roactively blocking time for priority tasks and deep work sessions (e.g., 3-hour client review blocks) Managing incoming meeting requests and calendar invites Coordinating scheduling via email and Calendly links Maintaining accurate availability and protecting focused work periods Adjusting calendar structure as preferences evolve (e.g., prioritizing mornings for deep work) Ensuring flexibility while maintaining structure Process Optimization & SOPs: Document, organize, and improve company workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) in Notion.

Support the creation of internal systems for accountability, task tracking, and delegation across the companie's operations and team structure.

Assist with invoicing (occurs approximately twice per month) Support with other tactical administrative tasks as needed Ensuring delegated tasks are followed up on and completed Reducing cognitive load by maintaining a clear, visible task pipeline Task Delegation & Tracking Implementing and maintaining a shared Notion workspace Capturing tasks from emails, meetings, and discussions Assigning deadlines and tracking progress Supporting transparency and real-time updates Preparing agendas for daily/weekly sync meetings Ensuring delegated tasks are followed up on and completed Reducing cognitive load by maintaining a clear, visible task pipeline Operational & Personal Support Developing and maintaining recurring operational checklists Tracking compliance deadlines (e.g., bi-annual certifications, audits) Managing recurring administrative tasks (e.g., invoicing support) Providing proactive reminders Improving operational consistency and service quality Preventing last-minute rushes and reducing operational risk Systems & Tools Communicate daily via Slack with structured updates.

Track tasks and delegation in Notion Help expand Notion usage for SOPs, documentation, and a lightweight CRM.

Executive Assistant to Founder | AI Scale-Up | Remote (London) with travel
I’m working with an ambitious AI scale-up that is approaching an exciting stage of growth as they move towards Series A. They are looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to work directly with the Founder and CEO, becoming a trusted extension of her and helping bring structure, organisation and efficiency to a fast-paced environment .
This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys working closely with a founder, managing competing priorities and playing a key role in helping scale a growing technology company.
This is not a traditional EA role focused purely on administration. You will play a key role in helping the Founder operate effectively day-to-day , managing communications, relationships and priorities across investors, customers, partners and the wider team.

Take ownership of the Founder’s busy inbox, prioritising communications, drafting responses and ensuring important conversations are followed up
Manage communications on behalf of the Founder with investors, prospective investors, angels, customers, startup programmes, partners and external stakeholders
Build trusted relationships and ensure all interactions reflect the professionalism of the business
Manage and organise a complex diary, ensuring the Founder’s time is prioritised effectively
Prepare meeting agendas, briefing notes, presentations and supporting materials ahead of important conversations
Support investor meetings, customer meetings, events and speaking engagements through preparation and coordination
Coordinate travel, accommodation and logistics, including international travel alongside the Founder when required
Track actions, deadlines and follow-ups to ensure key priorities are delivered
Work closely with teams across product, engineering and marketing to coordinate information and create polished executive materials
Support company-wide meetings, leadership activities and strategic events as the business continues to grow

Previous experience as an Executive Assistant supporting a Founder, CEO or senior executive in a fast-paced environment
Strong written communication skills, with the confidence to draft messages and communicate on behalf of a senior leader
Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities
Proactive and naturally solutions-focused, someone who anticipates what needs to happen rather than waiting for instructions
Comfortable handling confidential information with discretion and professionalism
Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to communicate confidently with senior stakeholders
Experience working in a start-up , scale-up or high-growth environment would be highly beneficial, but industry background is open

Calm, organised and adaptable in a changing environment
Comfortable working closely with a founder and gaining exposure across different areas of the business
Confident acting as a trusted representative of the Founder
Someone who enjoys variety, ownership and working at pace
A self-starter who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment

This is a remote-based role, offering flexibility around location. The successful candidate will need to be comfortable travelling internationally with the Founder when required, supporting meetings, events and speaking engagements.
The Founder has global travel planned over the coming months, so this role would suit someone who enjoys a fast-moving startup environment and the opportunity to be closely involved in the growth of the business.
Why this opportunity?
You’ll work directly with the Founder of a fast-growing AI company at a pivotal point in its journey, gaining exposure across investors, customers, partnerships, events and company building.
This is an opportunity to have a genuine impact, helping shape how a scaling technology business operates while becoming a key person the Founder relies on every day.

Job Title: Virtual Assistant – Customer Service Representative (Call-Focused Role) Location: Remote (Work from Home) Hours: 40 hours per week | 8-hour shifts between 2:00 PM SAST and 3:00 AM SAST (U.S. business hours) About the Role: We are seeking a highly motivated, emotionally intelligent, and professional Virtual Assistant to join our team as a Customer Service Representative (CSR).

This position is call-heavy, with an expected call volume of 100–150 calls per day. This is not a cold-calling role — all calls are service-related. You will be assisting existing customers, addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.

The ideal candidate will be calm under pressure, an excellent communicator, and skilled at handling occasional irate or frustrated customers with empathy and professionalism. Key Responsibilities: Handle 100–150 inbound and outbound service calls per day in a timely and professional manner.

Provide accurate information, resolve issues, and ensure customer satisfaction on every call. Maintain a positive, empathetic, and professional attitude toward customers at all times. Navigate customer service software and CRM tools efficiently to log details and track interactions.

Follow communication scripts and standard operating procedures while applying sound judgment. Escalate complex issues to appropriate departments when necessary. Meet or exceed daily call volume, quality, and customer satisfaction targets. Participate in regular team meetings, training sessions, and performance reviews.

Requirements Proven experience in customer service, call center, or virtual assistant roles (preferably in a U.S.-based support environment). Exceptional verbal communication and listening skills in English. Strong emotional intelligence and ability to de-escalate challenging interactions.

Reliable internet connection, loadshedding provisions and a quiet, distraction-free workspace. Proficiency with CRM platforms and call-handling software. Ability to multitask, stay organized, and manage time effectively. High level of professionalism, accountability, and attention to detail Benefits Competitive pay structure.

Remote work flexibility. Supportive and collaborative team environment. Opportunities for growth and skill development. Originally posted on Himalayas

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices.

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Executive Assistants and Corporate Administrators to join our Corporate Operations team. We ensure that the business runs smoothly and that travel, expenses and events are efficiently and correctly managed.
We look for positive team players who are self-driven and results oriented, with excellent attention to detail. The best candidates show that they are forward planners, reliable and determined, and keen to assume responsibility for projects, processes and policy. We are a unique global business, so we are not looking for candidates with extensive experience so much as excellent organisers and communicators who are keen to develop skills and strive for continuous improvement.
This team plays a crucial role in the overall operation of the business. They run significant business operations and processes, supporting the respective department leads but also taking central responsibility for logistics, expenses, travel and scheduling. They are the secret to our success!

We look for confident and effective people who have good judgment and the self-assurance to hold firm on a point of policy regardless of the seniority of people on the other side of a discussion. If you like to take responsibility and you like to ensure that things are done properly and efficiently then you will enjoy the role tremendously.
Location: This is a global operation, we have open roles in teams in all time zones.

Support operations for one or more departments in the company
Coordinate monthly reports and schedule meetings and interviews
Organise and run international company events including logistics
Manage quarterly and annual executive meetings
Collaborate across teams on activities and initiatives
Manage suppliers and stakeholders

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Maternity and paternity leave
Employee Assistance Programme

Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Responsibilities of this position require detailed coordination and integration of services, personnel, and financial resources.

Independently collaborate with administrative and clinical service chiefs, lead efforts to ensure integrated goals and priorities for the organization are met; Work routinely involves complex, difficult, or controversial issues, and actions have a direct and substantial impact on the effective functioning of the Medical Center, as well as the overall quality and cost effectiveness of patient care within the facility.

Major Duties include but not limited to: Management and Program Analysis Conducts and directs special studies and analyses of complex problems relating to manpower requirements, space and equipment utilization, organizational alignment, and other areas of concern to the executive leadership team Conducts in-depth studies to assess current needs or to project future needs.

He/she makes logistical type studies which are directed at determining the most effective utilization of space, supplies, transportation, storage facilities, etc.

Assists in the development of information submitted from this medical center to the VISN or VA Headquarters, which includes statistical and demographic information for various medical center health care programs, as well as any special reports required by the VISN Director.

He/she is responsible for all reports assigned to the Planner and has overall responsibility for the Medical Center's Strategic Plan. Analyzes and evaluates the effectiveness of existing service programs in meeting established program goals and objectives.

Develops evaluation methodologies and processes to study program effectiveness, organizational productivity, operational efficiency, and resource utilization Employs process improvement techniques and principles to achieve high performance in access, cost efficiency, patient satisfaction, and clinical quality.

Supports all internal, regional, and national programs related to quality improvement and employs system redesign management principles.

Participates in and/or leads activities and programs beneficial to the Medical Center including committees, task forces, investigations, performance improvement teams, and system redesign projects Develops organizational change management plans by evaluating proposed program changes, resources, deadlines, operating procedures, and other administrative parameters to determine impact on current operations, identify resources, requirements, challenges, and mitigations, establish stakeholders and timelines, and write detailed instructions, guidance, outlines, and correspondence Executive Assistance and Advising Facilitates resource allocation and associated decision-making, working closely with executive leadership in the formulation of the Medical Center budget, including allocation of funds and recommendations regarding staffing requirements, cost effective technological advances, equipment, space, projects, and supplies In collaboration with leadership, formulate policies and operating procedures, ensuring compliance with VA regulations, statutes and the standards and requirements of various internal and external bodies; assesses the impact of regional, national, and private-sector developments as they relate to local programs, making change recommendations accordingly Serves as the MCD representative and primary POC for Medical Center staff and provides full staff assistance on administrative matters affecting patient care, education and organizational policy; provides guidance for administrative activities of services related to budget and fiscal management, human resource management, strategic planning and program management and evaluation Researches and Interprets VHA and external policies, performance and survey requirements, standards, etc. and develops systems, policies, and procedures for these programs, ensuring they are aligned with VHA and other external requirements.

Provides policy and program guidance and advice to top management Supervisory Duties Provides first line supervision to the facility Patient Advocates and Outreach Coordinator, responsible for assigning and prioritizing subordinate workload, providing advice, counsel, or instructions to subordinates; developing and issuing performance standards; evaluating work and completing performance appraisals; identifying, communicating, and arranging for developmental and training needs of subordinates; resolving complaints, effecting minor disciplinary measures, and finding ways to improve production and increase efficiency of work through quarterly PATSR quality reviews Work Schedule: Full-time, 8:00am-4:30pm, Monday-Friday Telework: Ad-hoc as determine by Agency policy Virtual: This is not a virtual position.

Position Description/PD#: PD201170 Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not Authorized Critical Skills Incentive (CSI): Not Approved Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not Authorized
To qualify for this position, applicants must meet all requirements by the closing date of this announcement, 08/03/2026. Time-In-Grade Requirement: Applicants who are current Federal employees and have held a GS grade any time in the past 52 weeks must also meet time-in-grade requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

For a GS-13 position you must have served 52 weeks at the GS-12. The grade may have been in any occupation, but must have been held in the Federal service. An SF-50 that shows your time-in-grade eligibility must be submitted with your application materials.

If the most recent SF-50 has an effective date within the past year, it may not clearly demonstrate you possess one-year time-in-grade, as required by the announcement. In this instance, you must provide an additional SF-50 that clearly demonstrates one-year time-in-grade.

Note: Time-In-Grade requirements also apply to former Federal employees applying for reinstatement as well as current employees applying for Veterans Employment Opportunities Act of 1998 (VEOA) appointment.

You may qualify based on your experience as described below: Specialized Experience: You must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade GS-12 in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

Examples of specialized experience would typically include, but are not limited to: Progressively responsible analytical or administrative, or clinical management or supervisory experience in the health care field.

This work may have been performed in an operating health care facility or a higher organizational echelon with advisory or directional authority over such facilities.

Work must have involved a close working relationship with facility managers and analysis and/or coordination of administrative, clinical, or other service activities, and provided knowledge of the following: Missions, organizations, programs, and requirements of health care delivery systems; Regulations and standards of various regulatory and credentialing groups; and Government-wide, agency, and facility systems and requirements in various administrative areas such as budget, personnel, and procurement.

OR, Special Provision for Inservice Placement: Successful completion of an agency-sponsored on-the-job training program may be substituted for qualifying experience, provided it included a formal individualized training plan.

Such a training program must have been conducted in an operating health care system and included: Assignments providing a knowledge of basic health system administration philosophies, practices, and procedures, and basic government administrative policies and requirements; Practical assignments providing an opportunity to apply health system administration skills and principles (as the individual progresses, work assignments must be characteristic of the grade level to which he or she is assigned); and Oversight by an experienced health system administrator with periodic evaluation of the individual's progress and appropriate adjustment of the training program.

Preferred Experience: In-depth knowledge of VA, VHA, VISN 5, and Hershel Woody Williams VA Medical Center structures, functions, policies, and regulations in both clinical and administrative areas.

Expertise in healthcare administration, management, and current patient care trends; ability to analyze, negotiate, and resolve complex organizational issues. Skilled in budgeting, resource allocation, and supporting a multimillion-dollar healthcare system.

Altenrhein Aviation / Egli Paint (Aviation Plaza Altenrhein)
Un concept mis à l-épreuve
Aviation Plaza Altenrhein repose sur une promesse simple : trois spécialistes indépendants - Altenrhein Aviation pour la maintenance, AeroVisto pour la cabine, Egli Paint pour l-extérieur - travaillant dans un même aéroport, selon un même calendrier, durant un seul temps d-immobilisation. Pas une fusion ; un partenariat rodé à l-aéroport de St. Gallen-Altenrhein.
Le client qui a mis cette promesse à l-épreuve connaissait bien le lieu. Son Phenom 300 venait chez Altenrhein Aviation pour sa maintenance programmée année après année - une relation que le propriétaire décrit simplement : « Nous sommes comme une famille. » Lors de ces visites, AeroVisto intervenait régulièrement sur la cabine - accoudoirs, parties en bois, sièges - et son équipe visitait les ateliers pendant que d-autres rénovations prenaient forme.
Puis est venue l-inspection des 120 mois, l-événement le plus complet du calendrier de maintenance de l-avion. Le propriétaire a contacté Natascha Rode, directrice générale de AAL AG & Egli Paint GmbH, avec une décision qui a transformé un événement de maintenance en quelque chose de plus grand : profiter de l-immobilisation pour une rénovation complète - maintenance, cabine et extérieur, le tout en même temps.
Il est difficile de concevoir un projet plus dense sur un jet léger. Chaque métier réuni par l-Aviation Plaza, sur un même avion, selon un même calendrier - c-est précisément la complexité pour laquelle le concept a été conçu.
La partie maintenance
Chez Altenrhein Aviation, l-inspection des 120 mois a pénétré profondément dans la cellule, jusqu-à la révision du train d-atterrissage - selon les mots du propriétaire : « Ils doivent tout démonter. C-est vraiment quelque chose de majeur. » La préparation était à la hauteur.

L-inspection avait été planifiée avec le client environ un an à l-avance, et tout au long de la maintenance, une réunion hebdomadaire réunissait Altenrhein Aviation, l-équipe du client et Embraer autour d-une même table - les problèmes discutés tôt, les décisions prises rapidement.
« Ce n-est pas un travail facile - c-est un projet très, très difficile », déclare le propriétaire à propos de l-étendue de la maintenance. Sa conclusion : « Je suis très satisfait de ce qu-ils ont fait. »
La partie intérieure
Pour AeroVisto, le projet a commencé là où toute rénovation devrait débuter : par une inspection d-entrée documentée. Cela a changé le plan.

Le placage en bois, en service depuis plus d-une décennie, avait dépassé le stade où un simple revernissage était une option - ainsi, la menuiserie de la cabine a été replaquée puis montée jusqu-à une finition brillante brun foncé profonde qui reflète désormais la cabine autour.

Les parties plaquées racontaient une histoire similaire et ont été replaquées intégralement.
La nouvelle cabine paraît lumineuse, calme et précise. Six sièges 16G sont recouverts de cuir beige clair, avec une couture en losange qui donne à la cabine son détail signature ; le divan suit en cuir assorti.

Au plafond et le long des fenêtres, la garniture de plafond, les habillages de fenêtres et les lambrequins sont en ultracuir doux et clair qui laisse la lumière du jour faire son travail. Au sol, une moquette tuftée à la machine de ton tabac ancre la palette ; les monuments sombres et brillants l-encadrent.

Même les transitions sont soignées - nouvelles ceintures de sécurité en beige assorti, y compris les ceintures à airbag, les compartiments à bagages doublés, les escaliers d-embarquement finis avec un nouveau revêtement non textile, et le cockpit délibérément conservé dans son caractère existant avec un nouveau cuir gris moyen et une peau de mouton gris argenté.
Les décisions de design ont été prises sur place - lors des visites du client à Altenrhein, accueillies comme l-Aviation Plaza sait le faire : matériaux sur la table, ateliers à quelques pas, et Natascha Rode veillant à ce que chaque visite se déroule aussi bien que le projet lui-même.

Que le design final soit encore affiné alors que la production était déjà en cours n-a jamais posé problème - à un même endroit, les approbations, échantillons et travaux avançaient de concert.

Derrière tout cela, la voie de la certification : tests de combustion, données d-ingénierie approuvées, ordre d-ingénierie et formulaire 1 - la paperasse nécessaire avant qu-une cabine puisse être belle.
La partie peinture
Dans l-atelier de peinture moderne d-Egli Paint sur le site de l-Aviation Plaza, l-avion a reçu une finition extérieure complète - masqué, poncé et refini avec un brillant profond et uniforme. Et pendant que l-extérieur prenait forme, les travaux de maintenance et de cabine continuaient en parallèle, à quelques pas sur le même site.
Ce que change un même lieu
Un projet avec autant de métiers a un ennemi naturel : la distance. Le propriétaire, qui gère des projets aéronautiques depuis des années, le formule précisément : « Il faut finir A avant de passer à B. Si quelque chose doit être expédié de loin, cela peut retarder d-autres travaux. Quand la plupart des entreprises de soutien pour un projet comme celui-ci sont juste au coin de la rue, cela aide beaucoup. »
À Altenrhein, « au coin de la rue » est à prendre au sens littéral. Lors d-une visite, le propriétaire est passé chez AeroVisto et Egli Paint - à côté, selon ses mots. Les constats étaient discutés à l-avion, pas par chaînes d-e-mails. Et à travers tout cela, un niveau de soin personnel que le propriétaire résume en une phrase à propos de Natascha Rode : « Si vous appelez Natascha la nuit, elle est là pour vous. »
AeroVisto sert des clients dans le monde entier, et la distance n-a jamais été un obstacle : des solutions logistiques dédiées - démontage, emballage et transport gérés par les équipes d-AeroVisto - maintiennent même les projets complexes simples, où que soit basé l-avion. Et pourtant, l-Aviation Plaza ajoute quelque chose de spécial : chaque spécialiste, chaque décision, et le client lui-même - en un seul lieu.
La confirmation
Le projet s-est clôturé en personne : un contrôle qualité client sur place, puis le remontage final et la redélivrance - maintenance achevée, extérieur refini, cabine renouvelée du cockpit au compartiment à bagages. Un avion que le propriétaire appelle désormais, selon ses propres mots, « élégant et beau. »
Son verdict sur l-ensemble : « Après 120 mois, c-est plus ou moins comme si nous recevions un avion tout neuf. »
Et debout dans la cabine, il est allé plus loin dans le passé. Il avait déjà récupéré cet avion une fois - au Brésil, en 2015, à la livraison : « Regardez ce beau matériau. C-était exactement pareil quand je suis allé au Brésil pour recevoir cet avion - exactement comme ça. Tout neuf. »
Un propriétaire qui compare un avion à sa onzième année au jour où il l-a reçu - c-est le résultat que trois spécialistes se sont engagés à livrer, et la confirmation que le concept Aviation Plaza tient ses promesses.

APPLICANTS MUST MEET ALL OF THE FOLLOWING MINIMUM QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS FOR THE POSITION. To meet the minimum qualification requirements for this position, you must show that you possess the Executive Core Qualifications (ECQ) and Technical Qualifications (TQ) related to this position within your resume - NOT TO EXCEED 2 PAGES.

Resumes over the 2-page limit, will not be reviewed beyond page 2 or may be disqualified. Your resume should include examples of experience, education, and accomplishments applicable to the qualification(s). If your resume does not reflect demonstrated evidence of these qualifications, you may not receive consideration for the position.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS (TQs): Your resume must clearly demonstrate that you possess the following technical qualifications.

TQ 1: Demonstrates executive experience in providing leadership and direction to a complex scientific or technical organization, such as the management or oversight of nationally recognized large-scale research and development facilities or programs.

TQ 2: Demonstrates a general understanding of science and technology, as well as a working knowledge of and ability to oversee a wide variety of business and operational management systems.

EXECUTIVE CORE QUALIFICATIONS (ECQs): In addition to the Technical Qualification Requirements listed above, all new entrants into the Senior Executive Service (SES) under a career appointment will be assessed for executive competency against the following five mandatory ECQs.

If your 2-page resume does not reflect demonstrated evidence of the ECQs and TQs, you may not receive further consideration for the position.

There are five ECQs: ECQ 1: Commitment to the Rule of Law and the Principles of the American Founding - This core qualification requires a demonstrated knowledge of the American system of government, commitment to uphold the Constitution and the rule of law, and commitment to serve the American people.

ECQ 2: Driving Efficiency - This core qualification involves the demonstrated ability to strategically and efficiently manage resources, budget effectively, cut wasteful spending, and pursue efficiency through process and technological upgrades.

ECQ 3: Merit and Competence - This core qualification involves the demonstrated knowledge, ability and technical competence to effectively and reliably produce work that is of exceptional quality.

ECQ 4: Leading People - This core qualification involves the demonstrated ability to lead and inspire a group toward meeting the organization's vision, mission, and goals, and to drive a high-performance, high-accountability culture. This includes, when necessary, the ability to lead people through change and to hold individuals accountable.

ECQ 5: Achieving Results - This core qualification involves the demonstrated ability to achieve both individual and organizational results, and to align results to stated goals from superiors.

Note: If you are a member of the SES or have been certified through successful participation in an OPM approved SES Candidate Development Program (SESCDP), or have SES reinstatement eligibility, you do not need to respond to the ECQs.

Instead, you should attach proof (e.g., SF-50, Certification by OPM's SES Qualifications Review Board (QRB)) of your eligibility for noncompetitive appointment to the SES.

The Executive Assistant will provide critical support to our CEO and executive team while also gaining hands-on experience in startup building, product launch and marketing initiatives.

This role is perfect for an organized, highly energized, A-player, detail-oriented individual with a passion for health technology and a drive to make a difference in people’s lives and in an organization. You serve as a vital force multiplier for a team accelerating toward next financing round closure and global commercial expansion.

Moving beyond mere calendar management, you proactively anticipate organizational needs, safeguarding the CEO's bandwidth as our most critical asset. From investor relations to clinical partnership logistics, you execute across functions with absolute poise and precision.
If you need to be told what to do next, this isn't your role. If you thrive on context-switching, operate with discretion, and take ownership of outcomes, read on.

Provide comprehensive administrative support to the CEO and other executives.
Own CEO calendars, manages priorities, scheduling meetings, travel arrangements, and itineraries. Anticipate needs 2–3 steps ahead; resolve problems before they surface.
communication, including phone calls, emails, and correspondence.
Prepare presentations and reports for meetings and executive reviews.
Organize and maintain filing systems (both physical and digital).
Manage office logistics and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.
Possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate strong organizational and time management skills.
Maintain a high level of discretion and professionalism across personnel, legal, and financial matters
Prepare materials for meetings, board reviews, and executive presentations

s.h: MARKETING, INVESTORS, INTERNAL OPERATIONS AND OTHER ASSIGNMENTS
s.t:
Assist the team with developing and implementing marketing campaigns.
Conduct market research and competitor analysis.
Create social media content (posts, graphics, etc.) to promote iSono Health's technology.
Support with content creation for website and marketing materials.
Manage and analyze social media engagement metrics.
Assist with event planning and execution (trade shows, conferences).
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Creative and resourceful with an eagerness to learn.
Proficient in social media platforms and basic graphic design tools (a plus).
Support active fundraising: track investor pipeline, coordinate follow-ups, manage document flow.
Manage data room access, NDA execution, and due diligence document requests.
Coordinate scheduling and logistics for investor meetings, partner calls, and clinical site visits.

3+ years supporting a C-suite executive, startup or high-growth environment strongly preferred.
Unnervingly organized. You live by systems, not good intentions.
Exceptional written communication — you can refine an investor email or draft a LinkedIn post without hand-holding.
Strong confidentiality, discretion and high integrity.
Comfortable in the room when it matters: investor calls, partner meetings, board prep.
Proficient with Google Workspace, Microsoft, LinkedIn, Canva or equivalent tools.
Startup-ready: you don't wait for the process you build it.
Discreet, grounded, and unflappable under pressure.
Genuine interest in women's health, healthcare technology, or mission-driven work.
Proactive and positive attitude to work independently and initiate and complete projects.
Medical device or life sciences experience is a meaningful plus.
Strong project management skills is required.

iSono Health is building the future of breast care. Our platform, ATUSA, is the world's first wearable, AI-powered, automated 3D breast ultrasound system. FDA-cleared, clinically deployed across 14+ sites, and designed to make high-quality breast imaging accessible to every woman, everywhere.
We're a small, high-conviction team. We move fast, make decisions with data, and hold ourselves to a high standard, because the stakes are real. Breast cancer affects 1 in 8 women. Early detection saves lives. That's not a tagline. That's the work.
We're at an inflection point: Series A in process, clinical traction growing, and a product roadmap that extends well beyond one generation. The person in this role will have a front-row seat, and real responsibility, in what comes next.

Executive Assistant \- LE4 \- DFAT \- Geneva
About The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
The role of the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) is to advance the interests of Australia and Australians internationally. This involves strengthening Australia’s security, enhancing Australia’s prosperity, delivering an effective and high\-quality overseas aid program and helping Australian travellers and Australians overseas.

The department provides foreign, trade and development policy advice to the Australian Government. DFAT also works with other Australian Government agencies to drive coordination of Australia’s pursuit of global, regional and bilateral interests.

Under direction, the Executive Assistant to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador provides high\-level executive, administrative and organisational support at the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva. The position also organises official events and functions.
Due to the sensitive nature of the work involved, this position will need to be able to hold and maintain a national security clearance recognised by DFAT.
Key responsibilities of the position include but are not limited to:
Provide high\-level executive support to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador, ensuring the effective operation of executive offices in a fast\-paced and sensitive environment.
Manage and prioritise correspondence, invitations, briefing materials and requests, exercising sound judgement to determine priority, action and compliance requirements.
Coordinate official visits and delegation programs for Ministers, senior officials and high\-level visitors, balancing competing priorities and operational requirements.
Plan and deliver representational events, meetings and official engagements, liaising with internal and external stakeholders to achieve Mission objectives.
Manage representational expenditure and financial administration, including forecasting, acquittals, reconciliations and reporting in accordance with DFAT policies and procedures.
Coordinate travel, logistics and related administrative arrangements for executive leadership and official activities, ensuring compliance with relevant policies and procedures.
Monitor security, operational and workflow risks, implementing required controls and escalating issues as appropriate.
Provide administrative guidance, maintain effective business systems and support team coordination, contributing to continuous improvement and organisational effectiveness.

Proven experience in similar Executive Assistant role/s
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work with and support a team. Ability to develop and maintain respectful and effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders
Ability to manage time, prioritise, plan, handle multiple tasks and work well under pressure
Financial management and organisational skills
Discretion and sound judgement in handling confidential information
Extensive experience using Microsoft Office and electronic applications
Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills
Fluency in English is required, with fluency in French highly regarded
Knowledge of, or an ability to quickly acquire a knowledge of Australian Government legislation or departmental policy and guidelines in relation to the position duties
Desirable
Previous experience working in an embassy, international organisation, or comparable environment.

Australian NV2 security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain this. Therefore applicants must hold Australian citizenship to be considered.
Please note that candidates who hold citizenship or dual citizenship of Switzerland are not eligible for an Australian Security Clearance.

Medical Virtual Assistant (MVA)
Remote | Chiropractic Clinic | 30 Hours/Week | $5/hour with performance-based increase after 6 months

We are seeking a highly capable Medical Virtual Assistant (MVA) to support the overall operational health of a busy healthcare clinic. This role is ideal for someone who is very sharp, proactive, detail-oriented, emotionally intelligent, and able to take ownership of important clinic workflows with minimal supervision.
This is not a basic task-following role. The ideal candidate must be able to think ahead , identify operational gaps, take initiative, and help remove administrative and billing-related tasks from the provider's plate.
We are looking for someone with excellent English communication skills, strong executive presence, high accountability, and the ability to build a trust-based working relationship with the provider and care team.

Insurance Verification
Verify patient insurance after the patient checks in, typically around 15 minutes after the scheduled appointment time. Ensure all insurance information is accurate, updated, and properly documented.
Denied Claims Management
Review denied claims, identify denial reasons, and assist with claim reprocessing. Track issues, follow up on missing information, and help prevent repeat claim errors.
EOB Processing
Review and process Explanation of Benefits documents. Help organize, validate, and clear EOB backlogs while ensuring billing and insurance documentation is accurate.
Patient Balance Resolution
Review outstanding insurance balances and patient account issues. Track unresolved balances, identify the source of the issue, and coordinate next steps for resolution.
Claims Processing
Support claims-related workflows, including Cigna and Veterans Affairs claims. Ensure claims are reviewed, tracked, and escalated when necessary.
Payment Coordination
Assist with vendor payment coordination, including check payments when needed. Ensure payment-related tasks are completed accurately and on time.
SOAP Note Monitoring
Monitor SOAP note completion, accuracy, and compliance. Track missing, incomplete, or delayed documentation and communicate concerns appropriately.
Appointment Tracking
Track missed appointments, canceled appointments, and scheduling trends. Identify patterns that may affect clinic revenue, patient flow, or provider productivity.
Reports and Operational Tracking
Prepare reports on outstanding balances, missed appointments, canceled appointments, EOB backlog, denied claims, and other operational metrics. Reports should include clear insights and practical recommendations when needed.
Team Coordination
Support smooth communication between the provider, care team, and administrative staff. Help ensure updates are clearly shared, priorities are followed through, and important tasks are not missed.
Operational Support
Proactively identify workflow gaps, billing concerns, documentation delays, scheduling issues, and patient account problems. Recommend practical solutions to improve clinic efficiency.

Minimum of 1 year of experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant
Experience supporting a US healthcare practice
Experience with insurance verification, EOBs, claims, denied claims, patient balances, or billing support
Exposure to CPT and ICD-10 codes
Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal
Strong executive presence and professional communication style
Must be a Mac OS user
Strong attention to detail and follow-through
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
Proven leadership, ownership, or high-accountability experience in a previous role
Required Soft Skills
Proactive and able to anticipate needs before being asked
Highly detail-oriented with billing, documentation, and reporting tasks
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills
Emotionally intelligent and patient when working with a busy provider
Confident, professional, and organized in communication

s.h: Able to take personal responsibility for assigned work
s.t:
Resourceful and self-motivated when learning new workflows
Trustworthy, dependable, and comfortable handling sensitive information

Prior experience supporting a chiropractic clinic
Experience with Cigna or Veterans Affairs claims
Experience clearing EOB or billing backlogs
Experience preparing operational or billing reports
Experience mentoring, training, or supporting new team members
Experience working closely with a clinic owner, provider, or executive-level leader

Schedule: Monday to Friday

Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is someone who does not wait to be told every step. This person should be observant, organized, and confident enough to identify what needs attention.
They should be able to manage detailed billing and administrative tasks while also thinking about the bigger picture of clinic operations. The right candidate will be sharp, emotionally intelligent, highly reliable, and capable of becoming a trusted operational support partner for the provider and care team.

**Kanton Schaffhausen, Sozialamt**
Das Sozialamt des Kantons Schaffhausen erfüllt übergeordnete Aufgaben in den Bereichen Sozialhilfe und Alimentenhilfe, ist Entschädigungsbehörde in der Opferhilfe und zeichnet sich verantwortlich für die Bewilligung, Finanzierung und Aufsicht von Institutionen für Erwachsene mit Behinderung.

Das Sozialamt führt ausserdem die Fachstelle für Gleichstellung, Gewaltprävention und Gewaltschutz und ist für die Bewilligung von stationären Kinder- und Jugendeinrichtungen sowie für das Pflegekinderwesen zuständig.
Die Dienststelle nimmt darüber hinaus Aufgaben in Zusammenhang mit der Unterbringung, Begleitung, Integrationsförderung und materieller Unterstützung von Personen aus dem Asyl- und Flüchtlingsbereich wahr. En tant que **Coordinateur·trice de programme**, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la planification, l'organisation et la coordination des programmes et événements de la Fondation.

Vous assurerez le suivi des différentes étapes des projets, de leur préparation à leur évaluation, en collaboration avec les équipes internes, les bénévoles, les intervenants et les partenaires.

Vous veillerez à la bonne coordination des aspects logistiques, administratifs et organisationnels, tout en garantissant une communication fluide entre les différentes parties prenantes. **Planification et coordination des événements :**
* Participer à l-élaboration et à la mise en œuvre de la planification, des calendriers et des budgets des événements.
* Collaborer avec les équipes internes, notamment celles chargées de la communication et de l-accueil, afin d-harmoniser les objectifs et le contenu des événements.

* Coordonner la logistique avec le comité des événements, en gérant les listes d-intervenants.

**Communications, marketing et promotion :**
* Centraliser et fournir les informations sur le programme et les intervenants à l'équipe de communication pour la publication numérique et les présentations.
* Coordonner avec l'équipe de communication pour gérer la stratégie de promotion de l'événement, y compris les invitations, la planification sur les réseaux sociaux et les besoins en supports promotionnels.
* Suivre la participation en coordonnant les inscriptions et en surveillant les confirmations de présence avec les équipes de l'hospitalité et de la communication.
* S'assurer que tous les supports de l'événement (signalétique, programmes, badges et articles promotionnels) sont préparés en collaboration avec les équipes de l'hospitalité et de la communication.

* Superviser la mise en place, les inscriptions et la gestion des problèmes afin d-assurer un bon déroulement.

* Coordonner les installations audio-visuelles et les salles avec les prestataires.

* Coordonner les interprètes.

* Coordonner la facturation et la consolidation.

### **V-ZUG International Department** ###
V-ZUG steht für Schweizer Qualität und Präzision. International bewegen wir uns bewusst als anspruchsvoller Nischenplayer: Die International Markets verbinden unseren Hauptsitz in Zug mit Partnern, Märkten und Managing Directors weltweit. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir unsere Präsenz Schritt für Schritt weiter - mit klarem Fokus auf ausgewählte Märkte.
Unser Team ist klein, unser Wirkungskreis gross. Wir denken strategisch, handeln pragmatisch und bewegen uns täglich in einem Umfeld, das genauso international wie dynamisch ist. Kurze Entscheidungswege, eine CIO mit Gestaltungswille und ein Team, das füreinander einsteht - das ist unsere Arbeitsrealität.
### **Das bietet dir die Stelle** ###
* Du bist die zentrale Stütze der CIO und gestaltest ihren Arbeitsalltag aktiv mit: Du führst den Kalender proaktiv, koordinierst Dokumente für ExCo-Unterschriften und sorgst dafür, dass im Hintergrund alles reibungslos läuft
* Du planst und organisierst Meetings der International Markets von A bis Z: von der Einladung über die Agenda bis zum Protokoll - du hast den Überblick und den Drive, damit Meetings wirklich etwas bewegen
* Du organisierst Geschäftsreisen für die CIO und das Team sowie HQ-Besuche von Partnern und Managing Directors - massgeschneidert, durchdacht und bis ins Detail geplant, inklusive Programm, Locations und Abstimmung mit den Märkten
* Du übernimmst das Ausgabenmanagement der CIO und ihrer Direktberichte, überprüfst Spesenabrechnungen auf Regelkonformität und stellst einen sauberen SAP-Beschaffungsprozess sicher
* Du verantwortest das Office Management: von Büromaterial und Meeting-Supplies bis zur Korrespondenz und dem Handling von Marketingmaterial und Give-Aways für Kunden und Märkte
* Du planst und begleitest Onboarding- und Offboarding-Prozesse für Mitarbeitende - von der IT-Einrichtung bis zur strukturierten Einführung in die Organisation - und sorgst so für einen professionellen ersten und letzten Eindruck
* Du pflegst und entwickelst den Intranet- und SharePoint-Bereich der International Markets weiter und agierst als IT-Power-User: Du unterstützt die CIO und das internationale Team bei Beschaffungen und bist erste Ansprechperson bei technischen Fragen und Problemen
* Du bringst dich aktiv in Sonderprojekte ein: Du unterstützt bei PowerPoint-Präsentationen, bündelst und konsolidierst Informationen aus unterschiedlichen Quellen und übernimmst bei Bedarf eine tragende Rolle in Projekten - mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum
### **Das bringst du für die Stelle mit** ###
* Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine gleichwertige Grundausbildung - beispielsweise auch im Hospitality-Umfeld (z.-B. Hotelfachschule). Ein Weiterbildungsabschluss als Executive Assistant oder Direktionsassistenz ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss
* Du bist fit im gesamten Microsoft-Kosmos: SharePoint, Copilot, Outlook, Word, Excel und PowerPoint setzt du versiert und effizient ein - du weisst, wie man diese Tools wirklich nutzt, nicht nur bedient
* Du kommunizierst fliessend auf Deutsch und Englisch - schriftlich wie mündlich. Weitere Sprachen sind willkommen und ein echtes Plus in einem internationalen Umfeld
* Du bist dienstleistungsorientiert durch und durch: Du findest pragmatische Lösungen, behältst auch in turbulenten Situationen die Ruhe und trittst nach innen wie nach aussen professionell auf - als Visitenkarte der CIO und der International Markets
* Du denkst und planst voraus, handelst aus eigener Initiative und bist bereit, dir technisches und fachliches Know-how selbstständig anzueignen - Stillstand ist nicht dein Ding
* Du bist strukturiert, systematisch und zuverlässig - Menschen wissen, dass Dinge, die du übernimmst, erledigt sind. Und das mit der nötigen Sorgfalt
* Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen, bist unkompliziert im Umgang und kannst das Unternehmen professionell gegenüber externen Gästen, Partnern und Märkten vertreten - mit der richtigen Mischung aus Verbindlichkeit und Herzlichkeit

Für unsere Schule suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte, belastbare und dienstleistungsorientierte Persönlichkeit für die Schuladministration. Als zentrale Drehscheibe unterstützt du die Schulleitung und trägst wesentlich zu einem gut funktionierenden Schulbetrieb bei.
Die Schule Triengen umfasst rund 750 Lernende, welche von über 140 Lehrpersonen unterrichtet werden. Das Schulangebot umfasst sechs Kindergärten, 19 Abteilungen der Primarschule sowie 15 Sekundarschulklassen.
### **Deine Aufgaben**
* Anlaufstelle für Lehrpersonen, Lernende, Eltern und externe Ansprechpartner
* Erteilen von Auskünften sowie Triage und Koordination von Anfragen
* Führung der Lernendenadministration
* Finanzielle Abwicklungen und Mitarbeit im Globalbudget
* Administrative und organisatorische Unterstützung des Rektorats und der Schulleitungen
* Mitarbeit in der Personaladministration und bei schulischen Projekten
### **Du bringst mit**
* Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung
* Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Funktion, idealerweise im Bildungsbereich
* Weiterbildung oder Nachdiplomstudium «Leitung Schuladministration» von Vorteil
* Stilsichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent sowie vernetztes Denken
* Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise sowie eine hohe Dienstleistungsorientierung
· Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen, Teamfähigkeit und Belastbarkeit
* Positive Grundhaltung gegenüber Schule und Bildung
### **Wir bieten**
* Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
* Ein hilfsbereites, motiviertes Team und ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld
* Fortschrittliche Anstellungsbedingungen und Sozialleistungen
* Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell
* Individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
* Homeoffice\-Möglichkeit nach Absprache
* Attraktive Zusatzangebote wie Yoga über Mittag, Verpflegungsmöglichkeiten und kostenlose Parkplätze
